scope: Equivalent boolean email-policy matching with bounded scanning on admitted ASCII content
predeclared_guard: Less than 1000ms process CPU per public policy entry point; local regression guard, not production request quota
argument: Every legacy email match may extend left through the same local-part character class. Requiring a non-class predecessor therefore preserves existence of a match while avoiding retries from each suffix of one maximal prefix. The domain expression and policy categories are unchanged.
limits: This does not redefine valid email syntax or make the legacy detector RFC-complete.
Actual provider-envelope parse plus rendering/worker lifecycle is qualified separately in the final runtime image.
No provider calls or production mutations.
